### AMD Radeon™ RX 6700 Performance to Dominate Your Game

Powered by the breakthrough AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture, the PowerColor Fighter RX 6700 graphics card features 36 Compute Units, AMD Infinity Cache and 10GB of dedicated GDDR6 memory, is engineered to deliver ultra-high frame rates and ultimate 1440p gaming experience.

### Fighter Makes Your PC Powerful

The PowerColor Fighter RX 6700 graphics card is armed with a dual 90mm cooling fan design, a cooler with an enlarged heatsink surface, and Mute Fan Technology which can run in lower temperatures while providing a stable and outstanding high-performance experience.

...

### Powerhouse Performance for 1440p

AMD Radeon™ RX 6700 graphics cards deliver serious 1440p gaming and ultra-high frame rates. Get up to 36 high-performance compute units, groundbreaking AMD Infinity Cache, and up to 10GB of dedicated GDDR6 memory. Experience new levels of gaming performance with AMD Smart Access Memory technology when you pair an AMD Radeon™ RX 6700 graphics card with an AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Series desktop processor.

### Vivid Visuals

With immersive gaming technologies and support for DirectX® 12 Ultimate, AMD Radeon™ RX 6700 graphics cards draw you into the action. Experience 1440p gaming with realistic lighting, shadows, and reflections along with rich detail, thanks to DirectX® Raytracing (DXR), variable rate shading (VRS), and AMD FidelityFX features, optimized for AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture.

### Elevated Experiences

Level up to ultimate responsiveness and smooth gaming with low-latency gaming technology from AMD Radeon™ Anti-Lag and AMD Radeon™ Boost. Enhance your gaming experience with the latest HDMI™ 2.1 VRR technology, with over 1300 AMD FreeSync™ gaming displays to choose from, and support for motherboards with PCIe® 4.0 technology.

### AMD Radeon™RX 6700 XT性能，主导您的游戏

撼讯竞技RX 6700 XT显卡采用突破性的AMD RDNA™2架构，拥有40个计算单元、96 MB全新AMD infinite cache和12GB专用GDDR6内存，旨在提供超高帧率和终极2K游戏体验。

...

### 强大的 1440p 性能

AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT显卡带来卓越的 1440p 游戏体验与超高的帧率。 多达 40 个高性能计算单元、突破性的 AMD Infinity Cache 以及高达 12GB 的专用 GDDR6 显存。 当 AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT显卡搭配 AMD 锐龙 5000 系列台式处理器时，AMD Smart Access Memory 技术将助力游戏性能更上一层楼。

### 逼真的视觉效果

凭借沉浸式游戏技术和 DirectX® 12 Ultimate 支持，AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT显卡助您畅游游戏世界。 得益于 DirectX® 光线追踪 技术(DXR)、可变速率着色技术(VRS) 和针对 AMD RDNA 2 架构进行优化的 AMD FidelityFX 功能，您可以在逼真的光线、阴影和反射以及丰富的细节下体验 1440p 游戏。

### 升级体验

AMD Radeon Anti-Lag （抗延迟）与 AMD Radeon Boost 带来低延迟游戏技术，带给您全新的卓越响应能力和流畅的游戏体验。最新 HDMI 2.1 VRR 技术可增强您的游戏体验，更有 1300 余款 AMD FreeSync（游戏智能显示）游戏显示器可供选择，同时支持采用 PCIe® 4.0 技术的主板。
